Folder of the Florida Pasture Cube data

Source: R/dir.R
fpc_dir.Rd

The functions of this package read the data from one folder that has the layout of the release: fields.parquet, composites/composites_YYYY.parquet, labels/, optical_observations/, radar_observations/ and so on. fpc_download() fills it.

Usage

fpc_dir()

fpc_set_dir(path)

Arguments

path

Folder to use.

Value

fpc_dir() returns the folder path; fpc_set_dir() returns the previous one, invisibly.

Details

The folder is, in this order, the one set with fpc_set_dir() in this session, the environment variable FPCUBE_DIR, or a folder in the user's data directory (tools::R_user_dir("fpcubeR", "data")).

Examples

old <- fpc_set_dir(fpc_example_dir())
fpc_dir()
#> [1] "/home/runner/work/_temp/Library/fpcubeR/extdata/fpcube_example"
fpc_set_dir(old)
